classifications.rationale: FocusTrace validates role/property support and can surface unsupported aria-roledescription usage, but it does not reproduce axe's deprecated dedicated applicability contract.

FocusTrace reviews whether prerecorded audio-only content has an observable equivalent alternative; that overlaps the deprecated axe caption signal but intentionally follows the broader WCAG alternative requirement.
FocusTrace flags all duplicate IDs, including those on active elements, as a broader HTML authoring warning.
FocusTrace flags all duplicate IDs, directly including the deprecated axe rule's condition and preserving broader relationship evidence.
FocusTrace does not yet enforce top-level placement for complementary/aside landmarks.
